TJGC Group expects to fund repurchases using existing cash reserves, cash equivalents, and future cash generated from operations.

The repurchase program carries no fixed expiration date and does not obligate the company to acquire a specific volume of shares. The Board retains discretion to modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time without prior notice.
